name: mcp-server-test-actor
title: Apify MCP server test actor
description: Actor used for MCP server testing. Supports two execution modes: as an MCP server using the Apify standby mode and a normal actor mode

meta.generatedBy: Claude Code with Claude Opus 4.7 (1M context)

input.title: Actor input schema
input.description: Select the run mode and (in normal mode) provide the two numbers to add.

mode.title: Run mode
mode.description: How the actor should run. 'MCP server' starts an HTTP server exposing the MCP endpoint at POST /mcp (used in Apify Standby). 'Normal' reads firstNumber and secondNumber, pushes their sum to the dataset, and exits.

firstNumber.title: First number
firstNumber.description: First addend. Used only in normal mode.

secondNumber.title: Second number
secondNumber.description: Second addend. Used only in normal mode.

delay.title: Delay (seconds)
delay.description: Number of seconds to wait before computing the sum. Used only in normal mode.
